'''Trelleborg Municipality''' is a municipality and city in Skne in southernmost Sweden. It has a total population of three eight , four two nine , of which many live in rural districts and about two four , zero zero zero live in the city proper. 

Trelleborg is located on the southern shore of Sweden and is the southernmost municipality in Sweden. It covers an area of three four one . six km. It boosts three five kilometers of predomninantly sandy beach in the south, beech woods to the north, and in between one of the most fertile soils in the world. 

 History 
Trelleborg has been populated for at least one thousand years. In the one zero th century or earlier, a ''Trelleborg'' (ring fortress) was built by Danish Vikings. It was rediscovered in the one nine nine zero 's, and rebuilt, and now it hosts activities every summer. 

The first written mention of Trelleborg, in the scarce Swedish medieval sources, is from one two five seven , when Trelleborg and the adjacent city Malm where presented as a wedding gift from the Danish royal family to the Swedish Prince Valdemar. It was soon reconquered by the Danes and it belonged to Denmark until one six five eight , when the entire district Terra Scania was lost to Sweden in a war. 

In the medieval times, Trelleborg had an important part in the herring fishing. At that time, this was conducted along the entire coastal line of Sweden, as the herring shoals where of such great numbers that it has been reporter how fishermen could stand at the shore and land in fish with nets. Trelleborg became an important merchant city as merchants from Germany came to trade herring. In April one six one nine , the Danish King decided that one merchant city on the coastal line was sufficient and revoked Trelleborg's status as a merchant city to favour Malm.

It did however occur that the Trelleborgians continued with their business as a means of surviving. This was probably the start of the tradition of Trelleborgians being sly, wretched and only adhering their own rules. 

Not until one eight four zero was Trelleborg allowed to become a merchant city, and not until one eight six seven it regained its rights as a city of Sweden. Mostly this was thanks to the work of a few stubborn men, who had continuously been bothering the Swedish Riksdag with these requests ever since one six five eight . 
 
 Today 
In the end of the one nine th century, Trelleborg became an industrial town and the foundation of modern Trelleborg has largely been created by a few large companies; most notably Trelleborg Industries and the ferry company and business related to the seaport. Much of it has been the work of the influential businessman Johan Kock. Other important industries he established were ''Akzo Nobel Inks'', manufacturing printing inks (established as ''Gleitzman Industries'' in the one eight nine zero 's), and DUX, who make beds. Later in the one nine five zero s, Perstorp (Flooring) Industries was established in Trelleborg and it manufactures a type of flooring boards and other plastic material. Trelleborg continues to be a working-class oriented city and is politically a traditional stronghold for the the Swedish Social Democratic Party.

TT-Line ferry routes It is today often visited by people travelling from Sweden to Germany because of the ferries trafficking Rostock, Sassnitz and Lbeck - Travemnde in Germany. These ferries began touring on May one , one eight nine seven with the Sassnitz line; the route to Travemnde was established in one nine six two , while the line to the former East German city Rostock was augurated after the fall of the Berlin Wall in one nine eight nine . The ferries carry both passengers on one-day journeys, cars with vacationing families, and heavy trucks on their way through Europe. 

Today Trelleborg has the second largest seaport of Sweden, trailing Gothenburg. Every year it transports more than one zero million metric tons.

'''Vellinge''' is a Scanian town and the administrative centre of the Swedish municipality '''Vellinge Municipality'''. It is located immediately south of Malm in southern Sweden. It was formerly called Rng municipality. 

The municipality is considered to be one of the most economically well-off in Sweden, politically governed by a stable majority of the economically liberal party Moderaterna. Due to its low taxes, Vellinge is mainly populated by middle class families, many commuting to Malm (pop. two five zero , zero zero zero ).
 
There are four towns in the municipality with a population of over one , zero zero zero . All of them are best characterized as affluent suburbs within the metropolitan area of South-Western Scania:
 Hllviken, pop. nine , four zero zero ( one , five zero zero km)
 Ljunghusen, pop. two , four zero zero ( two , two five zero km)
 Skanr Falsterbo, a conurbation with a pop. of seven , one zero zero ( one , three zero zero km)
 '''Vellinge''', pop. six , zero zero zero ( two , zero zero zero km)

According to the local language usage, Hllviken, Ljunghusen, and Vellinge are not considered towns but rather denoted as villages . Skanr and Falsterbo, on the other hand, were important medieval towns.

A street in central Ystad

'''Ystad Municipality''' or is a Swedish municipality in Skne in southernmost Sweden. The Scanian city of '''Ystad''' is the seat with a population of roughly one six , zero zero zero . 
 

 Geography 


 History 
In the one three th century, the foundation of a town was established at the mouth of the ''Vassn'', a small river. The monastery ''Grbrdraklostret'', of the Franciscan order, was finished in the middle of that century. 

The coat of arms is derived from the Danish coat of arms and has been in use since the one four th century. Up until one six five eight , the southern provinces terra Scania were Danish territory.

 Today 
The main industries of the town is today handicraft and tourism. It is considered the city in Scania where the medieval buildings is best kept, and few cities in Sweden can measure its old pittoresque houses and street net.

The Saint Petri Church



The town houses two large medieval churches: The Saint Petri Church and the Saint Mary Church, both highly influenced by the gothic Hansa architecture that can be seen in churches around the Baltic Sea, for instance in Helsingborg, Malm and Rostock.

Ystad is known internationally as the setting for many of the novels of Henning Mankell, featuring fictional Ystad police inspector Kurt Wallander.

'''rkelljunga Municipality''' is a municipality and town in Scania in southern Sweden with its seat in the town '''rkelljunga''' (pop. four , four zero zero ). 

Geographically rkelljunga is situated in north-western Skne on the border to the provinces Halland and Smland. These parts of skne are notable for a varied terrain of leaf woods, farming areas and small lakes. 

Within the municipal borders is also a renowned golf course.

The closest large city is Helsingborg on the west coast, less than half an hour car drive away.

In sports, there is one team of national recognition and the pride of the town: rkelljunga Volleybollklubb. Usually both the male and female teams are top contestant in the highest national league; having won it on several occasions.

'''stra Ginge''' is a municipality in southern Sweden. The municipal seat is located in the town Broby with two , zero zero zero inhabitants. The municipality consists of largely rural areas. 

 Geography 
stra Ginge is part of Gingebygd, the area between Scania and the northern provinces Smland and Halland. It has varied geography. As most of Scania, the land is flat, and has good agricultural areas, but as the adjacent northern district Smalanda it has forests and lakes. The lake Helgen flows through the municipality and besides being lookworthy it offers good fishing.

 History 
The Gingebygd cherishes it history of ''Snapphanar'', a group of revolters in the one seven th century who were taking refugee in the forests. They where fighting the Swedish army in the times after the Treaty of Roskilde in one six five eight , when Scania became part of Swedish territory after being part of Denmark.

The dialect of the Ginge bygd has historically been distinguishable from the southern Scanian dialects as well as the northern Smalandian dialects, perhaps because the population took pride in a historical autonomousy and having been inhabited by resistance people.

The city arms depicts two palm trees crossing each other, a traditional symbol of peace and unity. It came into use after the treaty of Roskilde. The lower part of the arms depicts hammers, and was added when the municipality was joined with an adjacent municipality in one nine seven six l.

 Industry 
In stra Ginge Scania AB is located.

The '''Taiwan Solidarity Union''' (TSU) (Traditional Chinese:    , pinyin: Tiw n tanje lanmng) is a political party in Taiwan (Republic of China) which advocates Taiwan independence. Unlike the Democratic Progressive Party, its larger companion party in the pan-green coalition, the TSU actively campaigns for the creation of a de jure Republic of Taiwan. It was officially founded on July two four , two zero zero one and is considered part of the Pan-Green Coalition. The party prided itself on being the first to include Taiwan in its name.

Domestically, the TSU is characterized primarily by its Taiwanese nationalism and derives its membership from both the Nationalist Party's former Taiwan-oriented fringe and supporters of Taiwan Independence who are disgruntled by the Democratic Progressive Party's moderation on the question of Taiwanese sovereignty. 

In the summer of two zero zero one , supporters of former ROC president Lee Teng-hui formed the Taiwan Solidarity Union. In the two zero zero zero presidential elections, the KMT (Chinese Nationalist PartyKuomintang) suffered a devastating defeat, in which internal turmoil had caused the party to lose its grip on power. This was blamed on Lee, the KMT Chairman at the time, and he was forced to resign in March two zero zero one . The hardliners in the KMT and recently expelled supporters of James Soong believed Lee secretly harbored support for Taiwan independence and had purposely sabotaged the KMT (by not allowing Soong to run under the KMT) in order to allow Chen Shui-bian to win. Meanwhile, the new President Chen moderated his pro-independence position in the election, alienating some hardline independence supporters in his Democratic Progressive Party. By July, just months before the December two zero zero one elections to the Legislative Yuan, these factors accumulated to result in the formation of the TSU to continue Lee's policies, and fill in the DPP's abandoned position of an extremist hardline political force. It was hoped that this would lead to a pan-green majority in the nation's primary legislative body, thus giving the executive branch, under Chen, the political backing necessary to pursue more radical policies, primarily in the areas of Taiwanese independence.

The TSU's stated political aim is the advocacy of the creation of a Republic of Taiwan and a policy of desinicization which consists of eliminating the symbols and concepts which connect Taiwan to the idea of China. The TSU argues that any lingering connection with the concept of China renders Taiwan an abnormal nation and that clearly separating Taiwan from China is necessary to prevent Taiwan from being dominated by an enemy and foreign nation. The TSU has also strongly advocated the creation of a new constitution for Taiwan and abandonment of the Republic of China as Taiwan's formal name. 

Lee was, naturally, identified as the spiritual leader (though he personally never joined the party); the TSU hoped that Lee's popularity would help the TSU make the five % support mark. Further, Lee's dominance in the party was revealed when the candidates TSU nominated had all been personally approved by Lee beforehand. Meanwhile, as Lee's actions increasingly departed from the KMT's unificationist-friendly positions, he was eventually expelled from the Kuomintang. Although there was some initial speculation that Lee's expulsion would cause mass defections in the Kuomintang, none of the major Kuomintang leaders and Lee's close associates changed sides. Nonetheless, native members of the KMT was still to be the fundamental building blocks of the new party. Half of the TSU candidates had come directly from the KMT.

After winning nine seats in the two two five -member Legislative Yuan in December two zero zero one , the TSU has largely displaced the Taiwan Independence Party (TAIP) and TSU legislators began advocating resolutions consistent with its strongly pro-Taiwan independence stance. For instance, they have opened debate about changing the national flag and national anthem. In the December two zero zero two city elections in Taipei and Kaohsiung, during which it fielded no candidates, the TSU suffered a defeat, winning no seats in the Taipei City council and won only two seats in the Kaohsiung City council.

Yasukuni Shrine visit

The visit to the Yasukuni shrine by TSU chairman Shu Chin-chiang (  )in April two zero zero five  generated a controversy across the political spectrum and further makes their party goals more ambiguous to the voters. However, the TSU has made it clear that it would achieve its goal of total independence by all means. Chairman Shu denied the visit should be seen as support for militarism, and claimed it was a goodwill gesture to Taiwan's former colonial master Japan to further strengthen the security of the Pacific region. Chairman Su also emphasised that there is a need to remind the Taiwanese public that the People's Republic of China is aiming seven zero zero missiles towards Taiwan and that Japan would be an important ally if China were inclined to invade.

Chairman Shu's visit, however, gave opportunity to aboriginal legislator Kao Chin Su-mei (  ) to gain publicity by protesting with her supporters at the chairman's arrival at CKS airport. Later on the TSU press conference was disrupted by an angry mob from the members of pro-unification Patriot Association (   ), who showed their disagreement and dissatisfaction by throwing eggs at the conference building. The Democratic Progressive Party, the ruling party, kept a low profile in this controversy and attempts to distance itself from the incident.

Recent politics

The TSU suffered defeat in the December two zero zero five local elections, along with its pan-green partner the DPP, and failed to win any seats.

The '''Taiwan Independence Party''' (  , in pinyin: Jingud ng, literal meaning: Nation-establishing Party ) (TAIP) is a political party in the Republic of China on Taiwan.

It is usually associated with the pan-green coalition and supports Taiwan independence.

Disappointed by the Democratic Progressive Party's (DPP) gradual moderation of its support of Taiwan independence, some DPP members formed the Taiwan Independence Party in one nine nine six . However, the party has failed to win large-scale support, and it has largely been displaced as Taiwan's ideological independence party by the newly-formed Taiwan Solidarity Union (TSU).

 '''Jacksonville''' is a town located in Jackson County, Oregon, a few miles west of Medford. It was named for Jackson Creek, which runs through the community and was one of the first placer gold claims. As of the two zero zero zero census, the town had a total population of two , two three five .
 one eight eight three lithograph of Jacksonville.
 History 
Jacksonville was founded following discovery of gold deposits in one eight five one - two . With the creation of Jackson County, it became the county seat, which a role transferred to nearby Medford in one nine two seven .

Jacksonville was home to the first Chinatown in Oregon, founded by immigrants from San Francisco, California. Evidence of this otherwise forgotten chapter of history was uncovered early in March two zero zero four when road work uncovered artifacts dating to the one eight five zero s and one eight six zero s. Construction was halted while archeologists performed four days of rescue excavations. Their findings included broken Chinese bowls and tea cups, handmade bottles, and fragments of opium paraphernalia and Chinese coins.

When the gold deposits were worked out, and the railway bypassed Jacksonville in one eight eight four , the town's economy slowed. This had the unintended benefit of preserving a number of structures, which led to Jacksonville being designated a National Historic District in one nine six six , covering over one zero zero buildings. It was cited as a:
:mid- one nine th century inland commercial town significant for its magnificent group of surviving unaltered commercial and residential buildings. The town was the principal financial center of southern Oregon until it was bypassed by the railroad.

Jacksonville is noted locally for the visit of Rutherford B. Hayes and his wife Lemonade Lucy Hayes, who visited the area in one eight eight zero , staying the night in Jacksonville. More recently, it received publicity in October two zero zero five as the site of purchase of a Powerball lottery ticket with a $ three four zero million payout.

 Institutions and cultural events 
Jacksonville is home to the Britt Festival, a seasonal music festival taking place at an open-air amphitheater. The site was selected in one nine six three because of the acoustic qualities of the surrounding hills. The popular concert series draws national pop, country, alternative and contemporary music acts. It is named after Peter Britt, a pioneer and owner of the land now used for Britt Park.

 '''Medford''' is a city located in Jackson County, Oregon. It was named in the one eight eight zero s by a civil engineer working for the Oregon and California Railroad for his home town of Medford, Massachusetts. As of the two zero zero zero census, the city had a total population of six three , one five four . It is the county seat of Jackson County. Medford's sister city is Alba, Italy.

Meford is home to the Rogue Valley International-Medford Airport.

There's a giant bird statue at one eight one zero W. Main St.

 Economy 
Medford's economy is centered largely around agriculture and timber products. The largest direct marketer of fruits and food gifts in the United States, Bear Creek Corporation, is based in Medford. It is the second largest employer in Oregon, with three , five zero zero year-around employees and about one zero , zero zero zero seasonal. Bear Creek was founded in one eight eight six to market the harvest from the orchards of the Rogue Valley. Medford has a reigonal hub for medical services. The two major medical centers in the city employ over two , zero zero zero people.

 History 
Medford was incorporated as a city in one eight eight five .

Medford was founded along the Oregon and California Railroad line in the Bear Creek Valley, which is part of the greater Rogue Valley. The former name was Middle Ford . This was due to many possible reasons: it was at a midpoint position along the rail line, it was at the center of Bear Creek Valley, and it was near the crossing of Bear Creek. The name was shortened to Medford by a railroad engineer from Medford, Massachusetts named David Loring.

The city was divided by the construction of I- five in the one nine five zero s: the downtown and inner neighborhoods are on the west side of the freeway while the more affluent neighborhoods are on the east side. As a result, Medford has struggled for decades with urban decay affecting its core. West side renewal has come in the last decade, however, through a boom of new residential construction. 

A ballot measure to block building an interchange that would improve access between the two parts was rejected in the general election of November five , two zero zero three . Supporters claimed that it would only move traffic congestion from one location to another, while civic and business leaders warned it would cost the city $ three eight million in state and federal funds.

 '''Metolius''' is a city located in Jefferson County, Oregon. The city is named for the Metolius River, a nearby tributary of the Deschutes River.  History

 We're just trying to get the town to have its own personality again, said Metolius mayor Darrell Agee. Right now, it's solely a bedroom community for Madras. The Zip Code is just one step toward the future.

 '''Cave Junction''', incorporated in one nine four eight , is a city located in Josephine County, Oregon, United States. As of the two zero zero zero census, the city had a total population of one , three six three . It is the Gateway to the Oregon Caves . It was formerly a timber, ranching and mining community. In the years after World War II there were three zero lumber mills operating in the valley, and by the late one nine eight zero s the number had dwindled to just one, the result of clearcutting and over-harvesting on the surrounding mountainsides. Since about one nine six zero it has evolved into a center for wine, retirement, tourism, and small businesses.

 Geography 
 Location of Cave Junction in Josephine County, Oregon, USACave Junction is located at ( four two . one six six seven seven nine , - one two three . six four six nine nine nine ), on U.S. Highway one nine nine at the junction of State Route four six . It is about four eight km ( three zero mi) southwest of Grants Pass, Oregon and eight five km ( five three mi) northeast of Crescent City, California.

Cave Junction lies in the Illinois Valley, on the northwest slope of the Siskiyou Range, at an elevation of about four eight zero  m ( one five seven five  ft) above MSL.

According to the United States Census Bureau, the city has a total area of four . two km ( one . six mi ).  four . two km ( one . six mi ) of it is land and none of the area is covered with water.

 '''Grants Pass''' is a city and the county seat of Josephine County, Oregon. It is believed that its name is somehow related to general Ulysses S. Grant's capture of Vicksburg, Mississippi in one eight six three . As of the two zero zero zero census, the city had a total population of two three , zero zero three and the total population is estimated at two six , zero eight seven as of two zero zero five . Its sister city is Rubtsovsk, Russia.

 History 
Early hunters and trappers, following the Siskiyou Trail, passed through the site in the one eight two zero 's. Although a post office with the name Grants Pass was established on March two two , one eight six five , the city of Grants Pass was not incorporated until one eight eight seven , a year after when it had become the county seat.

In one nine two two , a group of local businessmen incorporated the Grants Pass Cavemen. Taking their name from the nearby Oregon Caves National Monument, this group was one of many groups of boosterism common in the United States at the time. For decades afterwards, this group would represent their city in countless public gatherings, dressed in furs and bearing clubs, performing such uncivilized acts as capturing female crowd members and politicians and putting them in their cages. To honor this group, in one nine seven one a fiberglass statue of a caveman was erected at the corner of Morgan Lane and Sixth Street. As a result, the local high school mascot is a caveman. The original monument was destroyed in two zero zero four as the result of a careless hoodlum that burnt the mascot. It was rebuilt finally in two zero zero five .

 Economy 
Historically the city's economy has been based on timber.

 Geography 
Location of Grants Pass, OregonGrants Pass is located at four two  two six ' two zero  North, one two three  one nine ' four two  West ( four two . four three eight nine six nine , - one two three . three two eight two four nine ).  '''Redwood''' is a census-designated place located in Josephine County, Oregon. As of the two zero zero zero census, the CDP had a total population of five , eight four four .

 Geography 
Location of Redwood, OregonRedwood is located at four two  two five ' one three  North, one two three  two two ' five three  West ( four two . four two zero two five six , - one two three . three eight one four eight six ).

According to the United States Census Bureau, the CDP has a total area of one two . seven km ( four . nine mi ).  one two . five km ( four . eight mi ) of it is land and zero . two km ( zero . one mi ) of it is water. The total area is one . two two % water.

During the one nine three zero 's and one nine four zero 's, this area was populated by only a few homesteads and was largely composed of marshland. Due to the ever constant croaking of frogs heard in the area by passersby late at night, the area was reffered to as the Frog Ponds despite the lack of ponds.

Starting in the mid one nine five zero 's, most of these marshlands were razed to make way for the first housing developments in the Redwood Area.

 '''Klamath Falls''' is a city located in Klamath County, Oregon. Originally called ''Linkville'' when George Nurse founded the town in one eight six seven , after the Link River on whose falls this city sits. The name was changed to Klamath Falls in one eight nine two - three , and is sometimes called '''K Falls'''. As of the two zero zero zero census, the city had a total population of one nine , four six two . It is the county seat of Klamath County.

 History 
The Klamath Indians were the first inhabitants of the area. Their name for this place was ''Yulalona'' or ''Iwauna'', which referred to the fact the Link River would flow upstream when the south wind blew hard. Their name for the falls was ''Tiwishkeni'', or where the falling waters rush .

Klamath Falls was incorporated as a city in one nine zero five .

The town has one of the worst unemployment rates in the state of Oregon since the collapse of the timber industry and has a significant crime rate related to methamphetimine There is a large community of Evangelical Christians. The Oregon Citizens Alliance was formed in Klamath Falls.

 Geography 
Location of Klamath Falls, OregonKlamath Falls is located at four two  one three ' two four  North, one two one  four six ' three nine  West ( four two . two two three four four one , - one two one . seven seven seven five seven eight ).

 Demographics 
As of the census of two zero zero zero , there are one nine , four six two people, seven , nine one six households, and four , six seven zero families residing in the city. The population density is one , zero eight nine . five mi ( four two zero . seven km ). There are eight , seven two two housing units at an average density of four eight eight . three mi ( one eight eight . six km ). The racial makeup of the city is eight five . one two % White, one . zero two % African American, four . four four % Native American, one . three two % Asian, zero . one three % Pacific Islander, four . one five % from other races, and three . eight three % from two or more races.  nine . three two % of the population are Hispanic or Latino of any race.

There are seven , nine one six households out of which three zero . zero % have children under the age of one eight living with them, four two . two % are married couples living together, one one . seven % have a female householder with no husband present, and four one . zero % are non-families. three two . four % of all households are made up of individuals and one one . nine % have someone living alone who is six five years of age or older. The average household size is two . three six and the average family size is two . nine nine .

In the city the population is spread out with two five . five % under the age of one eight , one three . one % from one eight to two four , two seven . two % from two five to four four , two one . five % from four five to six four , and one two . eight % who are six five years of age or older. The median age is three three years. For every one zero zero females there are one zero one . nine males. For every one zero zero females age one eight and over, there are one zero zero . one males.

 Economy 
Merle West Medical Center is the largest employer in the area, followed by Klamath Falls City School District and Jeld-Wen, a manufacturer of doors and windows.

 Colleges and universities 
Oregon Institute of Technology
Klamath Community College

 Recreation 
Klamath Falls is home to many outdoor winter and summer activities. The nearby Running Y Ranch Resort, features a golf course designed by Arnold Palmer, an ice skating arena Bill Collier Community Ice Arena, and overlooks Upper Klamath Lake, the largest natural lake in the Pacific Northwest.

 Coburg, Oregon
'''Coburg''' is a city (and a National Historic District) located in Lane County, Oregon, just north of Eugene. As of the two zero zero zero census, the city had a total population of nine six nine .

 History 
According to ''Oregon Geographic Names'' (OGN), the city was originally called '''Diamond''', the surname of the man upon whose land claim the city was located. ''OGN'' noted that the city's present-day name comes from a stallion which was named after the Coburg district of Bavaria, Germany, from whence the horse had been imported.

 Economy 
Coburg is headquarters for Monaco Coach Corporation, a major manufacturer of recreational vehicles. Monaco Coach also has a manufacturing plant in Coburg, as well as plants in Bend, and in Elkhart and Wakarusa, Indiana.

I- five .
Since at least two zero zero one , Coburg's city government has generated hundreds of thousands of dollars for its budget through speeding fines at an I- five speed trap located outside of city limits. By two zero zero three , the city was raising nearly half of its $ one . seven million annual budget through traffic fines; the $ seven five five , zero zero zero in traffic fines that year amounted to more than $ seven five zero per resident; it more than covered Police Chief Mike Hudson's salary of over $ one two four , zero zero zero that year, which is more than the salary of the Oregon State Police superintendent.

The speed trap was temporarily ended when a state legislator from Eugene sponsored bills to make the practice against the law, effective January two zero zero four . Police Chief Hudson also lost his job, following the adoption of the new law. But by July, the City Council annexed two six acres which included a mile-long segment of I- five ; affected property owners agreed to because it permitted them to erect illuminated signs along the interstate.

 Geography

As of November two zero zero four , that area grew at least two six acres (about zero . one km ) due to annexation east of the city designed to incorporate a section of I- five into city limits.

 '''Cottage Grove''' is a city located in Lane County, Oregon. It received its name from its first postmaster, G. C. Pierce, in September one eight six one . Pierce's home at the time was in an oak grove. As of the two zero zero zero census, the city had a total population of eight , four four five .

History
As was common in Oregon pioneer days, post offices for locations would move with each new postmaster, and it wasn't until the later one eight six zero s that the Cottage Grove post office arrived at its final location, in the extreme south west of present-day Cottage Grove. When the Southern Pacific Railroad built their line through the area, they built their station more than half a mile to the northeast of the post office, starting a bitter neighborhood disagreement. Since the inhabitants near the post office would not allow it to be moved next to the railroad station, a post office was established near the station, called Lemati, after the Chinook word ''lemiti'' for mountain. In one eight eight seven Cottage Grove was incorporated as a city, but the eastern community still used the placename Lemati intermittently until both communities were merged in one eight nine eight .

In one nine two six the spectacular locomotive crash from Buster Keaton's The General was filmed in the countryside, and the wrecked train became a minor tourist attraction until it was dismantled for scrap during World War II. Parts of the movie Animal House were filmed in Cottage Grove, and the two five th anniversary of the movie's release was celebrated August three zero , two zero zero three by the citizens with a toga party on Main Street. Main Street is where the climactic parade sequence from the movie was filmed.

'''Florence''' is a city located in Lane County, Oregon. One tradition states the city was named for state senator A.B. Florence, who represented Lane County from one eight five eight - one eight six zero ; another is that Florence was named for a French vessel that was wrecked at the mouth of the Siuslaw River February one seven , one eight seven five . As of the two zero zero zero census, the city had a total population of seven , two six three .

History
A fishing boat in the Florence, Oregon harbor

Following the one nine eight seven United States Supreme Court ruling in California v. Cabazon band of Mission Indians, which opened the door for Native American-owned casinos, the Confederated Tribes of Coos, Lower Umpqua and Siuslaw Indians sought to build one to improve their economic resources, and in one nine nine eight purchased a nine eight acre ( three nine seven , zero zero zero m ) lot one mile ( one . six km) to the east of Florence as the site of their casino. At first the U.S. Department of the Interior ruled that this land was not tribal property, which would prohibit the construction of the casino, but a subsequent court ruling overturned that decision. Then for a number of years, the state of Oregon fought the construction of casino. A local group, People Against a Casino Town (PACT), announced that they would file a lawsuit on September one five , two zero zero three to block the construction of the casino. PACT draws its support from the retirees who have settled in Florence over the last two decades.

Despite this opposition, the casino opened on June one nine , two zero zero four . Due to lack of local support, the casino has had to build its own sewer and water system, and provide its own police protection. While most Oregon cities that have worked with Native American groups in the planning and construction of their casinos (e.g. Lincoln City and North Bend) have shared in the revenues, no such agreement currently exists between the Confederated Tribes and Florence.

Many of the ideas in Frank Herbert's Dune series came to him during a trip to Florence to write a magazine article about a US Department of Agriculture project there.

Florence is also known as the site of the exploding whale, an incident when the Oregon State Highway Division tried to remove a beached whale by dynamite - with unintended results.

Aerial view of Florence

 '''Olofstrm Municipality''', or ''Olofstrms kommun'', is a municipality of Blekinge County in southern Sweden. It borders to Osby Municipality, Kristianstad Municipality, Bromlla Municipality, Slvesborg Municipality, Karlshamn Municipality, Tingsryd Municipality, and lmhult Municipality. The town of Olofstrm is the seat of the municipality.



The municipality is covered with forests and lakes. It labels itself The southernmost wildlife in Sweden , probably because there are scarsely any forests or lakes south of the Blekinge province.

Notable person that Olofstrm counts as theirs is Nobel Prize winning author Harry Martinson ( one nine zero four - one nine seven eight ; prize in one nine seven four ) who was born in the town Jmshg (pop. one , five zero zero ) within the municipality.

The increased use of cars in the one nine five zero 's and six zero 's was the great boost for the municipality. Today the car industry is the largest employer in Olofstrm.

Olofstrm is situated one zero km from Vilshult which is a small but well-known town in Sweden. It is widely recognised for a PV (photovoltaic) modules factory that has been located there since two zero zero one . In May, two zero zero five , it was reported that Olofstrm plans on building solar cells on the roofs of seven of its apartment houses. They would, if granted, form the largest solar cell park among the Nordic Countries and produce between seven zero , zero zero zero - one zero zero , zero zero zero kilowatt hours yearly.

 '''Junction City''' is a city located in Lane County, Oregon. As of the two zero zero zero census, the city had a total population of four , seven two one . Junction City was originally named by railroad magnate Ben Holladay around one eight seven zero , who decided this would be where the rail line on the east side of the Willamette Valley meet the rail line on the west side. However, the westside line was not built according to plan, although Junction City later was where the two main branches of U.S. Highway nine nine (which had divided in Portland, Oregon) joined.

 Geography 
Location of Junction City, OregonJunction City is located at four four  one three ' one four  North, one two three  one two ' one five  West ( four four . two two zero five one seven , - one two three . two zero four one four four ).

According to the United States Census Bureau, the city has a total area of three . six km ( one . four mi ).  three . six km ( one . four mi ) of it is land and none of the area is covered with water.

 History 
Junction City gained media attention throughout the United States in two zero zero three , when a number of local men posed in the nude for The Men of the Long Tom Grange Calendar to raise money for the local school district. This raised $ two two five , zero zero zero .

Junction City is home to the Scandinavian Festival, an annual four day event which pays homage to the cultures of Denmark, Finland, Norway, Sweden, and Iceland.

 '''Springfield''' is a city located in Lane County, Oregon, separated from Eugene, Oregon primarily by the I- five highway. Springfield was named after a natural spring located in a field or prairie within the current city boundaries. As of the two zero zero zero census, the city had a total population of five two , eight six four . Recent estimations put the population around six zero , zero zero zero .

 History 
The first settler who lived where Springfield currently is located was Elias Briggs in one eight four nine , who ran a ferry on the nearby Willamette River. Springfield was incorporated as a city in one eight eight five .

Because of their closeness, the two cities tend to complement each other: Eugene has the University of Oregon, Springfield a number of lumber plants; Eugene is liberal, Springfield somewhat more conservative; Eugene aspires to be upper middle class, whereas Springfield is proudly blue collar.

Many fans of the TV show The Simpsons believe this to be 'the' Springfield of the show, which holds some merit considering the time show creator Matt Groening spent in the area growing up, and other evidence (a popular park, for instance, bears a striking resemblance to the fictional Springfield's town square, the complementing of Springfield and Shelbyville).

 Geography

According to the United States Census Bureau, the city has a total area of three seven . three km ( one four . four mi ).  three seven . three km ( one four . four mi ) of it is land and none of the area is covered with water.

 Demographics 
As of the census of two zero zero zero , there are five two , eight six four people, two zero , five one four households, and one three , four seven seven families residing in the city. The population density is one , four one seven . four km ( three , six seven zero . seven mi ). There are two zero , five one four households out of which three five . three % have children under the age of one eight living with them, four five . seven % are married couples living together, one four . three % have a female householder with no husband present, and three four . three % are non-families. two five . four % of all households are made up of individuals and seven . eight % have someone living alone who is six five years of age or older.  '''Lincoln City''' is a city located in Lincoln County, Oregon, USA. It is named after the county. December As of the two zero zero zero census, the city had a total population of seven , four three seven .

 History 
Lincoln City was created after a vote on December eight , one nine six four to unite the cities of Oceanlake, Delake and Taft with the unincorporated communities of Cutler City and Nelscott. These were adjacent communities along U.S. Highway one zero one , which serves as Lincoln City's main street, and the highway traffic creating added congestion has been a recent problem.

In one nine nine five the Confederated Tribes of Siletz opened Chinook Winds Casino at the northern end of the city on a piece of property overlooking the Pacific Ocean. Although at first opposed by the local citizens, it provided a boost to the local economy, which is primarily based on tourism, by providing a year-around demand for hotel rooms.

 '''Toledo''' is a city located on the Yaquina River and along U.S. Highway two zero in Lincoln County, Oregon. As of the two zero zero zero census, the city had a total population of three , four seven two .

 History 
Toledo was first settled in one eight six six by John Graham, his son Joseph, and William Mackey, who claimed land made available by the Homestead Act. It was called Graham's Landing until a post office was established two years later; the Grahams then chose to name it after Toledo, Ohio, which had been their home for years before they headed west.

The city had its first mayor by one eight nine three when it was made the county seat of the newly established Lincoln County, and was incorporated in one nine zero five .

After the formation of the Spruce Production Division of the U.S. Army Signal Corps in November one nine one seven , Toledo was to be home to one of four major sawmills processing the old growth Sitka Spruce needed for the production of airplanes for the United States Army Air Service. The mill was not yet complete when World War I ended.

The newly-formed Pacific Spruce Corporation bought the uncompleted sawmill, a railroad line, and related equipment. and became a major employer in the area.

The county seat moved from Toledo to Newport in one nine five four .

 Geography

 Demographics 
As of the census of two zero zero zero , there are three , four seven two people in the city, organized into one , three one two households and nine two six families.  '''Millersburg''' is a city located in Linn County, Oregon. Millersburg originally was the name of a station on the Southern Pacific railroad line, which was named for a local farming family. As of the two zero zero zero census, the city had a total population of six five one .

 History 
Millersburg came into being in one nine seven four , to prevent the city of Albany from attempting to extend its city limits to include where Wah Chang Corporation operated a zirconium processing plant for the United States Bureau of Mines. 

Although now owned by Teledyne, this processing plant is the city's largest employer, and effectively runs the city. 

Millersburg's infamous stench of past years, often attributed to the Wah Chang facility, but actually generated by the Weyerhauser wood products processing mill, has lent support to various attempts to close both plants.

 '''Sweet Home''' is a city located in Linn County, Oregon. As of the two zero zero zero census, the city had a total population of eight , zero one six .

 History 
The Sweet Home Valley of the South Santiam River was first settled in one eight five one . By one eight six five a freight wagon and livestock toll road extended from the Sweet Home Valley across the Santiam Pass of the Cascade Mountains to Camp Polk in Central Oregon. The Santiam Wagon Road was a vital means of supplying livestock and goods from the Willamette Valley to Central Oregon and transporting wool from east of the Cascade Mountains back to Western Oregon woolen mills. The wagon road collected tolls until around one nine two one . Competition with railroads that extended south from the Columbia River into Central Oregon and the newly opened McKenzie River Pass highway in the one nine three zero 's made the wagon road obsolete by around one nine three nine . Later, US Highway two zero was constructed across much the same route as the Santiam Wagon Road. In the one nine nine zero 's, efforts began to restore abandoned sections of of the Santiam Wagon Road to hiking and other recreational activities. 

The first community in this Sweet Home Valley was named Buckhead after the name of the Buckland saloon on nearby Ames Creek. Another community a short distance from Buckhead was called Mossville. By the one eight eight zero 's the two communities had expanded towards each other and the combined village was named Sweet Home. The City of Sweet Home was incorporated in one eight nine three . By the one nine eight zero 's Sweet Home had expanded to include the community of Foster.

 Geography 
Location of Sweet Home, OregonSweet Home is located at four four  two four ' two  North, one two two  four two ' five seven  West ( four four . four zero zero five one three , - one two two . seven one five seven three six ).

According to the United States Census Bureau, the city has a total area of one four . nine km ( five . eight mi ).  one three . eight km ( five . three mi ) of it is land and one . one km ( zero . four mi ) of it is water. The total area is seven . six four % water.

The region encircled by Sweet Home is rich with arsenic, presenting a problem for the residents using the drinking water there. 

 Demographics

 '''Jordan Valley''' is a city located in Malheur County, Oregon. The city was named after Jordan creek, a tributary of Owyhee River, which runs through the town; the creek is named for a one nine th century prospector, Michael M. Jordan. As of the two zero zero zero census, the city had a total population of two three nine .

 History 
Jordan Valley was incorporated as a city in one nine one one .

In the center of town stands a ''pelota fronton'', built in one nine one five by Basque settlers, many of whom had been recruited from Spain to herd sheep. Their descendants are a noticeable presence today in Malheur county.

 Geography 
Location of Jordan Valley, OregonJordan Valley is located at four two  five eight ' three five  North, one one seven  three ' one nine  West ( four two . nine seven six four three nine , - one one seven . zero five five two seven seven ).

According to the United States Census Bureau, the city has a total area of five . four km ( two . one mi ).  five . four km ( two . one mi ) of it is land and none of the area is covered with water.

Jordan Valley is known for its excellent hunting and fishing as well as its proximity to Jordan Craters, an extinct volcanic caldera. 

Young people of the town enjoy rabbit kicking in their free time.

'''Enkping Municipality''' is a Swedish municipality in Uppsala County, in east central Sweden. Seat in '''Enkping''' with one nine , zero zero zero inhabitants.

Enkping was once known for its cultivation of horseradish.

 Geography 
Enkping is situated in the province of Uppland near Lake Mlaren, about seven eight km west of Stockholm.
A comparably large number of Swedish cities are located in the vicinity of Enkping. The municipal slogan is therefore Sweden's Closest City . This expression was created in one nine six five when it was discovered by a local business that within a radius of one two zero kilometers, one finds three eight Swedish cities and one three of Sweden's population.

 History 
Near Enkping, there is some of the best preserved rock art from the bronze age present in central Sweden. The city of Enkping itself dates its history back to the one two th century but the city itself did not emerge until about one two five zero . Enkping was then as now situated by the rich farmlands close to lake Mlaren, leading to a wealthy rural population. The city has also always been a major crossroads for commerce, and excellent communications signify the city even today: The Mlar Railline (''Mlarbanan'') and the E one eight highway provide ample means of travelling to the nearby major cities of Stockholm and Vsters. The city has several manufacturing industries, a hospital and the Army Signaling Regiment, the Uplandia Regiment (''Upplands Regemente''). 

Enkping cirka one seven zero zero , from Suecia antiqua et hodierna.

 Sister cities 
 S:t Karins, Finland, 
 lstykke, Denmark, 
 Nedre Eiker , Norway 
 Jgeva, Estonia

The Nordic cities have a long tradtion as sister cities. The Estonian city started in the one nine nine zero s as a help project. 

(Source: )

 Sports 
The most successful sports team of the city has for several years been the football team Enkpings SK, with one peak season in the Swedish Premier Division (Allsvenskan) in two zero zero three . Unfortunately, the team has now faced the harsh reality of sports and economics and will be playing in Division two the next season. Their home arena is called Enavallen Stadium and is situated in central Enkping.

 Downtown Ontario.
Ontario's location in Oregon.
'''Ontario''' is the largest city in Malheur County, Oregon. It lies along the Snake River at the Idaho border. As of the two zero zero zero census, the city had a total population of one zero , nine eight five . The city is the largest community in the region of far eastern Oregon, also known as the Western Treasure Valley.

Ontario is the principal city of the Ontario, OR-ID Micropolitan Statistical Area, which includes Malheur County in Oregon and Payette County in Idaho. 

Ontario is approximately halfway between Portland and Salt Lake City. It is the closest city to the Idaho border along Interstate eight four . The city's slogan is Where Oregon begins .

 Economy 
The region's primary industry is the cultivation of russet potatoes, sugar beets, and onions. Ontario also has a growing retail-based economy which attracts shoppers from throughout the county and, perhaps more significantly, from Idaho's Payette County, particularly nearby Payette and Fruitland. Big box retailers Wal-Mart and Home Depot dominate, but the lack of a sales tax in the state attracts shoppers (and relocating retailers) from Idaho communities. It also attracts employees, who benefit from a minimum wage which as of two zero zero five is four zero % higher than the one paid in Idaho.

The Four Rivers Cultural Center, named after the Snake, the Malheur, the Owyhee and Payette Rivers, has a museum which traces the history of settlement in the area by the Northern Paiutes, Basque, Japanese Americans, and Hispanic and European American immigrants. The center's theater and conference center contribute regional dollars to the local economy, as does the Treasure Valley Community College, located near the cultural center.

Ontario's role as a regional center of economic growth is challenged by the westward expansion of Boise, Idaho, about fifty miles east of the city. While Oregon's lack of a sales tax is an asset, the state's land use laws make it hard for the city to grow a property tax base and match the pace of development seen across the state line in Idaho. An article in the August one four , two zero zero five edition of ''The Oregonian'' noted that half of the staff of the Snake River Correctional Institute, Oregon's largest state prison and a large Ontario employer, live in Idaho, commuting daily across the state line. The article also noted that the land use laws that protect farmland across the state work to a farmer's disadvantage if farmers cannot find a way to compete profitably.

Main Street (now Oregon Street) looking south, early one nine two zero s.

 History 
Ontario was founded on June one one , one eight eight three developers by William Morfitt, Mary Richardson, Daniel Smith, and James Virtue, in anticipation of a railroad planned to go through that part of the state. It was named after Virtue's home province of Ontario in Canada. 

Ontario was incorporated in one eight nine six .

 Geography 
Ontario is located at four four  one ' three seven  North, one one six  five eight ' seven  West ( four four . zero two six eight three seven , - one one six . nine six eight six seven two ). It is at an elevation of two , one five zero feet above sea level. Ontario is on the OregonIdaho border. Interstate eight four goes through the city.

According to the United States Census Bureau, the city has a total area of one one . six km ( four . five mi ).  one one . six km ( four . five mi ) of it is land and none of the area is covered with water.

 Demographics 
As of the census of two zero zero zero , there are one zero , nine eight five people, four , zero eight four households, and two , six three four families residing in the city. The population density is nine four eight . eight km ( two , four five nine . three mi ). There are four , four three six housing units at an average density of three eight three . two km ( nine nine three . one mi ). The racial makeup of the city is six nine . two seven % White, zero . five five % African American, two . six nine % Asian, zero . eight eight % Native American, zero . one five % Pacific Islander, two three . zero nine % from other races, and three . three nine % from two or more races.  three two . zero five % of the population are Hispanic or Latino of any race.

There are four , zero eight four households out of which three five . six % have children under the age of one eight living with them, four seven . four % are married couples living together, one three . one % have a female householder with no husband present, and three five . five % are non-families. three zero . four % of all households are made up of individuals and one five . four % have someone living alone who is six five years of age or older. The average household size is two . six three and the average family size is three . three zero .

 '''lvkarleby''' is a municipality in Uppsala County, in east central Sweden. The municipality covers an area of two zero eight . five km. Of the total population of eight nine three two , four four six six are male, and four four six six are female. The population density of the community is four three inhabitants per km. lvkarleby is located by the Gulf of Bothnia, about one six five kilometers north of Stockholm. The municipal seat is located in Skutskr.

 History 
Not until late in the Bronze Age ( one zero th century BC) did parts of what is now lvkarleby begin to rise out of the Baltic Sea. Remains of settlements from that period has been found in the area. In the Early Iron Age ( six th- one two th century) the population began to grow and people supported themselves on farming, hunting, fishing and livestock. The first mention of lvkarleby is found in documents from the early Middle Ages ( one three th century). 

lvkarleby was the hometown of the author Stig Dagerman.

 '''Aurora''' is a city located in Marion County, Oregon. It was named by its founder, Dr. William Keil, ( one eight one one - one eight seven seven ) after his daughter. As of the two zero zero zero census, the city had a total population of six five five .

 History 
After a railway connected Bethel, Missouri with the outside world, Dr. Keil decided to take his followers and flee Bethel for a new location. In one eight five five he travelled to the Northwest, and after spending a dismal winter on the Willapa River in present-day Washington state, Dr. Keil bought two square miles on Deer Creek, a tributary of the Pudding River, and rebuilt his Christian Socialist commune in one eight five six . Aurora was incorporated as a city soon after. Upon his death, the communal possession of the lands was ended, and title of the lands distributed amongst the inhabitants, although for some decades afterwards Aurora was noted for its German heritage

For many years, Aurora was another business center for the farmers of its portion of the Willamette Valley, but beginning in the one nine eight zero s a number of antique stores opened in the old city center, and now form the principal commercial activity of the city.

 '''Detroit''' is a city located in Marion County, Oregon. It was named for Detroit, Michigan in the one eight nine zero s because of the large number of Michiganders in the community. As of the two zero zero zero census, the city had a total population of two six two .

 History 
The original townsite of Detroit was inundated in the summer of one nine five two when the Corps of Engineers finished Detroit Dam on the Santiam River. The community was relocated about a half mile northwest of the original site, on State Highway two two , and was incorporated as a city the same year.

Because of its location near Detroit Lake and Detroit Lake State Park, Detroit's economy is dependant on tourism. The community suffered from a drought in two zero zero one , when Detroit Lake was little more than the Santiam River through the summer.

 '''Keizer''' (IPA: ) is a city located in Marion County, Oregon. It was named for Thomas Dove and J.B. Keizer, two pioneers who arrived in the wagon train of one eight four three , and later filed donation land claims. As of the two zero zero zero census, the city had a total population of three two , two zero three . The town hosts the Salem-Keizer Volcanoes baseball club of the Northwest League. It is also home to the McNary High School Celtics, the lone High School in the City.

 History 
The original settlement was at '''Keizer Bottom''', near the banks of the Willamette River. This settlement suffered in the flood of one eight six one , and the inhabitants rebuilt their homes on higher ground. Further floods in one nine four three , one nine four five , one nine four six and one nine four eight hampered the growth of the community, and it was not until dams were built in the one nine five zero s to regulate the flow of the Willamette that Keizer began to flourish.

Many times the City of Salem tried to annex the growing community adjacent to its city limits. Beginning in one nine six four a number of Keizer residents, tried to convince the people of Keizer that it would be cheaper and better to form their own city. It was not until November two , one nine eight two when, with the support of the nearby unincorporated community of Clear Lake, residents voted to make Keizer a city.

 Geography 
Location of Keizer, OregonKeizer is located at four five  zero ' two  North, one two three  one ' one nine  West ( four five . zero zero zero four nine one , - one two three . zero two one eight eight five ).

 '''Mount Angel''' is a city located in Marion County, Oregon. This city was named after Engelberg, Switzerland, where Rev. Fr. Adelheim Odermatt, O.S.B., received his theological training. As of the two zero zero zero census, the city had a total population of three , one two one .

History
Mount Angel was originally settled in one eight five zero by Benjamin Cleaver, who later planned a townsite which he named Roy. A post office with that name was established in one eight eight two .  

Rev. Fr. Adelheim Odermatt came to Oregon in one eight eight one , and shortly afterwards ministered to several local Roman Catholic parishes, about the same time large numbers of immigrants from Bavaria settled in the area. Due to his efforts, the city, post office and the nearby elevation Lone Butte came to be known as Mount Angel. He also established Mount Angel Abbey, a Benedictine monastery and school, which was moved permanently to Mount Angel in one eight eight four . 

The City of Mount Angel was incorporated April three , one eight nine three .

In the one nine three zero 's the German American Bund (a pro-Nazi organization) was popular
in Mount Angel.

To this day, the Mount Angel Abbey is perched atop Lone Butte, now known as Saint Benedict, Oregon.

 Geography 
Location of Mount Angel, OregonMount Angel is located at four five  four ' eight  North, one two two  four seven ' four nine  West ( four five . zero six eight seven six zero , - one two two . seven nine six nine one six ).

According to the United States Census Bureau, the city has a total area of two . five km ( one . zero mi ).  two . five km ( one . zero mi ) of it is land and none of the area is covered with water.

 Demographics 
As of the census of two zero zero zero , there are three , one two one people, one , zero five nine households, and six six one families residing in the city. The population density is one , two five five . two km ( three , two six four . three mi ). There are one , one two four housing units at an average density of four five two . one km ( one , one seven five . six mi ). The racial makeup of the city is seven five . six five % White, zero . four five % African American, zero . nine three % Native American, zero . one nine % Asian, zero . one zero % Pacific Islander, one seven . eight five % from other races, and four . eight four % from two or more races.  two seven . eight four % of the population are Hispanic or Latino of any race.

There are one , zero five nine households out of which three five . five % have children under the age of one eight living with them, four eight . zero % are married couples living together, one zero . eight % have a female householder with no husband present, and three seven . five % are non-families. three three . one % of all households are made up of individuals and two zero . five % have someone living alone who is six five years of age or older. The average household size is two . seven five and the average family size is three . five four .

In the city the population is spread out with three zero . two % under the age of one eight , eight . five % from one eight to two four , two five . one % from two five to four four , one seven . nine % from four five to six four , and one eight . two % who are six five years of age or older. The median age is three four years. For every one zero zero females there are nine two . five males. For every one zero zero females age one eight and over, there are eight five . three males.

Out of the total population, one six . six % of those under the age of one eight and two zero . two % of those six five and older are living below the poverty line.

Attractions
Mount Angel is well-known locally for its Oktoberfest, and for its Benedictine monastery, Mount Angel Abbey, in nearby Saint Benedict, Oregon. Mount Angel is also known for the Bavarian Haus, a fine restaurant in downtown Mount Angel.

Colegio Csar Chvez

Colegio Csar Chvez was a college-without-walls program that existed in Mt. Angel from one nine seven three until one nine eight three . At the time, Colegio was the only four year Chicano, or Mexican American, college in the country. The college was named after civil rights leader Csar Chvez, who visited the college on two occasions.

The Arts in Woodburn

Chris Klein filming Hallmark Hall of Fame Production Valley of Light in downtown Woodburn

There are a few institutions in Woodburn that are devoted to teaching and presenting the arts. Willamette Ballet Academy was founded in one nine eight two . World's Berry Center Museum was founded in the early one nine eight zero s as well. The World's Berry Center Museum occasionally produces plays by Miracle Theater.

Kat B'jelland of the punk band Babes in Toyland, grew up in Woodburn. Her first performance was at the now-closed tavern ''Flight nine nine ''.

Hallmark Hall of Fame Production recently filmed a scene from Valley of Light, starring Chris Klein, in downtown Woodburn . Despite high expectations, it was reported that the production brought only $ eight zero zero to the City of Woodburn, and some local residents felt that the filming crew treated onlookers in a harsh and unfriendly fashion.

Woodburn Company Stores

In two zero zero zero , Woodburn Company Stores opened in Woodburn. This is a factory store mall with many name brand clothing companies represented, including Adidas, Nike, and Banana Republic. This shopping mall is one of the most visited attractions in the state of Oregon with around three , five zero zero , zero zero zero visitors per year, second only to the various Indian casinos throughout the state.

McLaren Correctional Facility

On the outskirts of Woodburn, on nine nine -E, is MacLaren Youth Correctional Facility, which incarcerates delinquent and criminal boys. Most notably, Kip Kinkel, who in one nine nine eight killed his parents, is held at MacLaren.

History

Woodburn was founded by Jesse H. Settlemier. There is a museum called the Settlemier house located on Settlemier Avenue, both of which were named after him.

Woodburn has a history of being a large farming community. One large and growing problem this has created recently is the number of illegal immigrants in the area. The school system has federal funding to provide free lunch in all schools. However, over crowding has become a high concern. Another issue behind illegal immigration is that it has created a high number of uninsured drivers. Another rising issue is the increase of drug use. Many times illegal immigrant families are tempted to make more money by delaling various drugs, most noteably Marijuana and meth. The reason behind this is that migrant workers who are illegal have a difficult time making a living getting paid small wages in the agricultural business and they are desperate to make more income. However, federal aid is provided to the area. With federal programs such as migrant housing, this provides many migrant families a place to live. The Woodburn Police dept. has been helping immensly with crime in the area.

 The town of '''Heppner''' is the county seat of Morrow County, Oregon, USA. It was originally called '''Standsbury Flat''' for George W. Standsbury, one of the first white settlers in the area. It was later renamed to honor Henry Heppner, a Jewish pioneer who opened the first general store there in one eight seven three . As of the two zero zero zero census, the city had a total population of one , three nine five .

History
Heppner was designated the temporary county seat at the time Morrow County was created and narrowly defeated Lexington in the election held in one eight eight six to determine the permanent county seat. It was incorporated the following year.

Heppner was almost destroyed by a flood on June one four , one nine zero three . The flood was precipitated by a sudden cloudburst and accompanying hail that caused a dam collapse and flash flooding. A wall of water and debris swept down the creeks and canyons and through the town. It has been estimated that two two five people or a quarter of the town's population was drowned. Property damage was reported at nearly $ one , zero zero zero , zero zero zero . The nearby towns of Ione and Lexington also sustained significant damage.

 Population Decay 
The population of Lexington has decayed at a rate of about one zero % per decade since about one nine six zero . This is in contrast to Morrow County as a whole, which has seen its population more than double since one nine six zero . Most population movement is to the nearby town of Heppner, or to larger cities such as Portland. As a result, Lexington's only school closed down after the one nine nine seven school year with less than five zero students, who now attend Heppner Elementary School or Heppner JrSr High School. The population decay has caused many problems, chief among them real estate values for the area. The average home value in the Lexington is about $ six zero , zero zero zero and declining steadily. About one zero % of actively upkept homes are vacant, with several dozen more homes existing in decrepit states after decades of vacancy.
