 '''Mount Lebanon''' is a census-designated place and municipality in Allegheny County in the U.S. state of Pennsylvania. As of the two zero zero zero census, the CDP had a total population of three three , zero one seven . The town's and high school's longstanding nickname is Lebo .

History
The first white settlers arrived in one seven seven three - one seven seven four , having purchased the land from the descendants of William Penn; other pioneers soon bought land from the state government. 

In one nine one two , '''Mount Lebanon Township''' was incorporated as a First Class Township under Pennsylvania state law. It had formerly been a part of Scott Township, which in turn traces its origins to the long-defunct St. Clair township. Mount Lebanon was named for two Cedars of Lebanon trees from Palestine that were planted in one eight five zero on land that is now part of the Mt. Lebanon Country Club.

In one nine two eight , Mount Lebanon became the first First Class Township in Pennsylvania to adopt the council-manager form of government and has had an appointed manager serving as the chief administrative officer since that time. 

Mount Lebanon became a streetcar suburb almost immediately: the first line through the area opened in one nine zero two , the second in one nine two four . Between the one nine two zero and one nine three zero censuses, the township's population skyrocketed from two , two five eight to one three , four zero three .

On May two one , one nine seven four , the electorate approved a Home Rule Charter, which took effect on January one , one nine seven five making Mount Lebanon one of the first municipalities in Pennsylvania to adopt a home rule charter. In the charter, the official name of the municipality became '''Mt. Lebanon, Pennsylvania'''; the word Mount is abbreviated in all government documents.

 Geography 
Mt. Lebanon is located at four zero  two two ' three six  North, eight zero  two ' five seven  West ( four zero . three seven six seven six nine , - eight zero . zero four nine one one zero ). According to the United States Census Bureau, the CDP has a total area of one five . seven km .

Mt. Lebanon is a streetcar suburb six miles south of downtown Pittsburgh. There are two small borders with Pittsburgh to the northeast, but most of the northeast border is with Dormont. Immediately north, Green Tree has an intersection bordering Mt. Lebanon. The entire western border is with Scott Township. To the south are the two towns which, due to their comparable size and affluence, are most often compared with Mt. Lebanon: Upper St. Clair to the southwest and Bethel Park to the southeast. To the east is Castle Shannon, and finally, to the northeast, the tiny Baldwin Township (not to be confused with Baldwin Borough).

Mt. Lebanon's main business district is uptown , in the city center along Washington Road. There are sizable business districts along the borders with Dormont, Upper St. Clair, and Castle Shannon, as well.

Pittsburgh's light rail, the T , has three stops in the municipality: Mount Lebanon Station (in uptown, between Route one nine Washington Road and Shady Dr East), Poplar Dr (at Pennsylvania Blvd), and Arlington (curiously named, since the station is on Cooke Lane near the Lebanon Shops). Route one nine is the only intercity road to travel through Mt. Lebanon.

 Demographics 
As of the census of two zero zero zero , there are three three , zero one seven people, one three , six one zero households, and nine , zero two three families residing in the CDP. The population density is two , one zero seven . one km ( five , four five seven . two mi ). There are one four , zero eight nine housing units at an average density of eight nine nine . one km ( two , three two eight . seven mi ). The racial makeup of the CDP is nine six . two one % White, zero . six one % African American, zero . zero seven % Native American, two . two nine % Asian, zero . zero one % Pacific Islander, zero . one eight % from other races, and zero . six two % from two or more races.  zero . eight zero % of the population are Hispanic or Latino of any race.

There are one three , six one zero households out of which three one . three % have children under the age of one eight living with them, five seven . three % are married couples living together, seven . two % have a female householder with no husband present, and three three . seven % are non-families. three zero . six % of all households are made up of individuals and one three . five % have someone living alone who is six five years of age or older. The average household size is two . three seven and the average family size is three . zero zero .

In the CDP the population is spread out with two four . eight % under the age of one eight , four . zero % from one eight to two four , two six . nine % from two five to four four , two five . four % from four five to six four , and one eight . eight % who are six five years of age or older. The median age is four two years. For every one zero zero females there are eight seven . one males. For every one zero zero females age one eight and over, there are eight two . one males.

The median income for a household in the CDP is $ six zero , seven eight three , and the median income for a family is $ seven nine , seven four four . Males have a median income of $ five six , one eight three versus $ three seven , zero zero eight for females. The per capita income for the CDP is $ three three , six five two .  three . five % of the population and two . two % of families are below the poverty line.  Education
Mt. Lebanon is well known in the region for its public school system. While school taxes are higher than average and the schools are recognized as being very professionally managed, much of the district's success is due to the fact that the majority of parents in Mt. Lebanon are college graduates, and expect the same of their children. 
Mt. Lebanon High School has been named a National Blue Ribbon School by the U.S. Department of Education each of the three times it requested certification: one nine eight three - eight four , one nine nine zero - nine one , and one nine nine seven - nine eight . The other schools have been awarded with similar frequency.

In the two zero zero two - zero three school year, the high school received one of six Outstanding School Awards from the Educational Theatre Association, which said the school's theater program serves as a model for the type of program the association promotes. The school's theater program began in one nine three zero , and has produced a number of notable actors.

The Class of two zero zero two graduated four three zero students, nine seven % of whom went on to some form of full-time college and nine six % of whom took the SAT. Their cumulative mean score of one one four seven is one two seven points higher than the national mean and one four nine points more than the Pennsylvania mean score.

 '''North Versailles''' is a first class township and coextensive census-designated place located in Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. As of the two zero zero zero census, the township had a total population of one one , one two five .

 History 
North Versailles Township was formed September one eight , one eight six nine by a division of (the original) Versailles Township into North and South Versailles Townships. Versailles Township was one of the original seven townships of Allegheny County formed in one seven eight eight from Westmoreland County. Additionally, the land which encompasses the present day North Versailles Township was disputed territory between Pennsylvania and Virginia which claimed the area as part of Yohogania County of the District of West Augusta. 

The territory designated in one seven eight eight as Versailles Township now contains the townships of North Versailles and South Versailles; the boroughs of White Oak, East McKeesport, Wall, Versailles, and portions of Wilmerding and Trafford; as well as the major portion (excluding one zero th ward) of the City of McKeesport. 

North Versailles was further divided with the formation of the boroughs of East McKeesport ( one eight nine three ), Wall ( one nine zero four ), and portions of the boroughs of Wilmerding ( one eight nine zero ) and Trafford ( one nine zero four ). The section of Wilmerding on the north side of Turtle Creek was originally part of the former Patton Township and the majority of Trafford is situated in Westmoreland County. An area of North Versailles (Allequippa Grove later known as North McKeesport and Highland Grove) was also annexed by the City of McKeesport. 

Early villages and population centers in North Versailles included Port Perry, Saltsburgh and Allequippa Grove along the Monongahela River; Pleasant Hill near to what is now East McKeesport; Point Pleasant located near the present intersections of Route three zero and McKee and Naser Roads; and Stewart's Station, Spring Hill, Mosside Station, Wall Station, and Wilmerding Station along Turtle Creek, a tributary of the Monongahela River.

North Versailles has a number of named neighborhoods including the following which roughly corresponds to the township's seven wards:

Ward one : Park Terrace
Ward two : Arlington
Ward three : Sunset and South Wilmerding
Ward four : Green Valley and Fite Station
Ward five : West Wilmerding
Ward six : Dixon Hollow and Oak Hill
Ward seven : Crestas Terrace

At one time, North Versailles was served by eight volunteer fire departments. Each ward was served by one department with the exception of Ward three which had both the Sunset and South Wilmerding VFDs.  Ward four and six 's fire departments were the Green Valley VFD and Dixon VFD respectively. Currently three fire stations serve the township. 

 Fire Department of North Versailles

Schools

North Versailles, East McKeesport, Wilmerding, and Wall consoldated school systems in the early one nine six zero s to form the East Allegheny School District. East Allegheny High School (the Wildcats - one nine six nine ) is situated off of Rt. four eight (Jack's Run Road) near the intersection of Rt. three zero . Green Valley School ( one nine five five ) is the only surviving school of the former North Versailles School District which included (but is not limited to) the following other schools during the township's history: 

Port Perry School
Saltsburg(h) School
Bowman School
Pleasant Hills School
Spring Hill School
Kincaid School
Point Pleasant School
Oak Hill School
North McKeesport School
Arlington School
Sunset School
South Wilmerding School
Dixon Avenue School
Crestas School
Keith School
West Wilmerding School
Park Terrace Junior High

Prior to the formation of the East Allegheny School Disctrict, North Versailles high school age students were able to choose to go to one of several high schools in other districts including: East McKeesport High School (the Rams), Westinghouse Memorial High School (the Wildcats), Turtle Creek High School (the Creekers), McKeesport Area High School (the Tigers), and East Pittsburgh High School (the Shamrocks).

At the formation of the East Allegheny School District, Westinghouse Memorial High School became the district's official high school until the building of East Allegheny High School in one nine six nine . The former East McKeesport High School was transformed into a Junior High servicing East McKeesport, Wilmerding, Wall and certain portions of North Versailles near East McKeesport.  Park Terrace Junior High ( one nine five five -- the Bobcats) served the township. During the one nine six eight - six nine school year, Park Terrace was designated a middle school serving all seventh and eighth graders in the district and East McKeesport served only nine th grade students for this one year; it would serve other populations until its demise. Neither school building exists today.

 East Allegheny School District

According to the United States Census Bureau, the township has a total area of two one . four km ( eight . three mi ).  two one . zero km ( eight . one mi ) of it is land and zero . four km ( zero . two mi ) of it is water. The total area is one . nine three % water.

Photo of the George Westinghouse Bridge at the western terminus of North Versailles Township.
North Versailles borders the Monongahela River to the west, Turtle Creek to the west and north, North Huntington, Westmoreland County to the east, and the City of McKeesport and the borough of White Oak to the south. The township surrounds East McKeesport, Wilmerding, and Wall.

The Lincoln Highway, US Route three zero traverses North Versailles and on its western border crosses the Turtle Creek valley via the George Westinghouse Bridge into East Pittsburgh. 

Other highways in the township include: PA four eight (Jack's Run RoadMosside Blvd -- the Orange Belt) and PA one four eight (Fifth Avenue Extension -- the Yellow Belt). In addition to Routes four eight and one four eight , Greensburg Pike Section two and the East Pittsburgh McKeesport Blvd. provide access to the Tri Boro Expressway.

 '''Upper St. Clair''' is a township located in Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. It is located about ten miles south of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. As of the two zero zero zero census, the township had a total population of two zero , zero five three . The Township of Upper St. Clair was named in honor of General Arthur St. Clair, the ninth President of the United States in Congress Assembled under the Articles of Confederation. 

History
The original white settlement was in one seven six three , near where Washington and McLaughlin Run roads now intersect.

Originally part of St. Clair Township, Upper St. Clair Township was formed in one eight three six after residents decided that, among other reasons, they deserved prompter road repair services.

The community was home to several mines beginning in the late one eight zero zero s. Freehold Real Estate Co. built the first major residential development in March one nine one three along Washington Road that at the time was conveniently close to streetcar service.

 Geography 
Upper St. Clair is located at four zero  two zero ' eight  North, eight zero  four ' four seven  West ( four zero . three three five six three six , - eight zero . zero seven nine seven two one ).

 '''Wilkinsburg''' is a borough located in Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. As of the two zero zero zero census, the borough had a total population of one nine , one nine six , having lost more than one zero , zero zero zero in six zero years since one nine four zero , when two nine , eight five three people were enumerated. The borough was named in honor of William Wilkins, Secretary of War under President Tyler. 

In one nine one nine , the world's first commercial radio station, KDKA, began broadcasting here from a small garage owned by Frank Conrad. In one nine two three , Wilkinsburg-based Russian immigrant Vladimir Zworykin designed and patented the iconoscope, the photocell eye of early television cameras. Today ABC affiliate WTAE-TV is located in the borough on Ardmore Blvd.

Wilkinsburg was founded and developed by highly religious European immigrants. The borough has a remarkably high concentration of churches, mostly Protestant, which is unusual in a predominantly Catholic region of the country. Also, bars are prohibited within the borough limits. In one eight seven one , Wilkinsburg separated from the city of Pittsburgh in order to (according to borough leader James Kelly) maintain the religious integrity of the community.

In more recent years, the borough has fallen on harder times, with many of its residents living in public housing. On March one , two zero zero zero , Wilkinsburg received unwanted national attention when Ronald Taylor, a man suffering from schizophrenia, killed three people and wounded two others in a spree that occured (in part) at the local Burger King and McDonald's restaurants . Other deaths caused by violent acts have been common occurrences, but are known only locally.

 '''Kittanning''' is a borough located in Armstrong County, Pennsylvania, four four miles ( seven one km) northeast of Pittsburgh. Early in the twentieth century, it had large iron and steel works, foundries, coal mines, glassworks, flour and lumber mills, China, pottery, brick, lime, and clay works, mirror and typewriter factories, breweries, etc. In one nine zero zero , three , nine zero two people lived in Kittanning, and in one nine one zero , there were four , three one one inhabitants. After Kittanning merged with Wickboro, an estimated one zero , zero zero zero residents lived in Kittanning in one nine one four . In one nine four zero , seven , five five zero residents existed. As of the two zero zero zero census, the borough had a total population of four , seven eight seven . It is the county seat of Armstrong County. It is located on the east bank of the Allegheny River, founded on the site of the one eight th century Native American village of Kittanning at the western end of the Kittanning Path. The village was destroyed by a British raid in one seven five six during the French and Indian War. The blast from the explosion of gunpowder stored in the chief's house was heard in Pittsburgh, four five miles away.

It was the filming location for the two zero zero two movie, ''The Mothman Prophecies''. You can read who was in front of the camera with Richard Gere and Laura Linney in the Kittanning Message Board.

 History 

Leechburg sign

Leechburg was founded in one eight five zero by David Leech.

'''The following text is from:'''

Source: Page one three five - one four six , Armstrong County, Pa., Her People, Past and Present, J. H. Beers Oldtown, just one mile east, across the Kiskiminetas river, below Carnahan's run, and Jacksonville, two miles west, each had more population than the settlement of Friendship, as the site of Leechburg was then called. The first house here, a log one, was located near the site of the present Grace Lutheran church, back of the lot on which the high school now stands. It stood near a large spring north of Siberian avenue, near Spring alley. Addison Leech had the water of this spring piped to his residence on Market street, the present residence of Hon. Joseph G. Beale. For many years this spring supplied a large number of the citizens with water; in fact it was almost a public resort until the waterworks were built in one eight nine one .

The site of Leechburg was for the most part patented by White Mattock, an Indian chief, in August, one seven eight three , while John Vanderen had also patented a parcel of land part of which Leechburg now occupies Feb. one O, one seven seven three , ten years before. White Mattock's grant consisted of one nine two - one two acres and the main business and residence portion of Leechburg is on this tract. Among the early owners of Leechburg's site was John Walker, to whom this land was surveyed in October, one seven seven three , but he seemed never to have taken out title papers. Other later owners were William P. Brady, Jacob Mechling, Frederick Steif, Joseph Hunter, Matthew Shields and David Leech. The site was later called White Plains, and the names of White Mattock and Matthew Shields appear in most all old deeds, especially those which came from David and his son Addison Leech. The first two settlers in Leechburg, as far as any history records, were Joseph Hunter, mentioned above, and Michael Moorhead, a drover by occupation. They owned cabins near the Big Spring. 

Leechburg was very prosperous in the past during the building of the old Pennsylvania canal, and was the headquarters of the promoters and builders of that famous connecting waterway between the Atlantic ocean and the waters of the Mississippi valley. This canal west of the Allegheny mountains was supplied entirely by the waters of the Conemaugh and Kiskiminetas rivers (they being the same stream under different names), and did more to develop the middle and western States than any other enterprise before or after. It paved the way for the construction of the Pennsylvania railroad and supplied a convenient and cheap means of transporting food and merchandise for the early inhabitants of the western part of the State.

David Leech came to this place in one eight two seven , having the contract to build the Pennsylvania canal dam, in partnership with a man named Trux. The dam was three six feet high and five seven four feet long, and boats commenced to use the canal in one eight two nine .

Leech used the water from this dam to run his flouring and saw mills and a woolen factory from one eight two nine to one eight three two . Thereafter he was engaged in building freight and passenger boats for use on the canal. His was the second boat to pass through the canal to Pittsburgh. In all, he had at one time eight boats in constant use on the canal, until it was superseded by the Pennsylvania railroad, the railroad company purchasing it from the State.

These mills, after David Leech's death, came into the hands of his son, Addison, and after him were operated by R. D. Elwood & Bro. The old mill building is now used by the Leechburg Oil & Paint Co. as a manufactory of paints and painters' supplies.

In addition to the above-mentioned enterprises the founder of Leechburg was, soon after he settled here, engaged in the mercantile lines of trade and together with his sons was afterward extensively engaged in the same business. He was, from one eight five three till one eight five six , an active member of the firm of Leech, Chamberlain & Co., engaged in the construction of the Allegheny Valley railroad from Pittsburgh to Kittanning. His vigorous constitution began to yield to the weight of years, the numerous cares and responsibilities of his active life and to the approach of disease, in one eight five seven , and he died November three , one eight five eight , regretted and esteemed, at home and abroad.

The growth of Leechburg began with the completion of the canal. The first brick house was built in one eight three zero by Solomon Moore. It has long since been removed to give place to a more modern dwelling. Leech was a great builder himself, and there are several of the substantial brick homes of his construction still in use. The old Leech residence is still in a fine state of repair.

 '''Richie Sambora''' (born '''Richard Stephen Sambora''' on July one one , one nine five nine in Woodbridge, New Jersey) is best known as the lead guitarist for Bon Jovi, handles harmony and background vocals, and joins frontman Jon Bon Jovi in writing most of the band's songs over the course of their twenty year run. He has also released two solo albums, Stranger In This Town in one nine nine one , and Undiscovered Soul in one nine nine eight . Sambora attended Woodbridge High School. His main influences were Eric Clapton, Jimi Hendrix, Jeff Beck, and Joe Kmiecik.

Richie played on a recently released album called Lessons from a band called Message . The album was recorded in the early one nine eight zero s. His guitar work is also featured on the track ''Misery'' on Pink's two zero zero one album Missundaztood with Steven Tyler.

In two zero zero four , Sanctuary Records released a self-titled album which had been recorded in one nine seven eight by Shark Frenzy, documenting Sambora's first recorded material. The mix tapes had been damaged in a flood and it had taken band member Bruce Foster to remaster them for them to be released so many years later.

Richie got his first guitar when he was just one two years old. Throughout his career as a guitarist, Richie has displayed an impressive knack for feeling out a guitar solo to the point that it not only follows the key of the song, but the chord progression as well. His technique displays remarkable variety - his soloing in Wanted Dead or Alive is laden with artificial harmonics, whereas his riffing for Livin' on a Prayer makes extensive use of palm muting. Developing his guitar technique in an era laden with wild soloing inspired by Eddie Van Halen, Richie developed a unique style of speed and precision but it took him a few attempts to impress Jon Bon Jovi. When Jon first saw Richie play he didn't think he was good enough; however, he soon changed his opinion after working with Richie. Richie was also one of the first eight zero s mainstream guitarists to make use of the talkbox. The talkbox was also used by other guitarists, notably Slash from Guns N' Roses, Jeff Beck, Joe Perry of Aerosmith, and Peter Frampton. The talkbox can be heard clearly in Livin' on a Prayer and It's My Life .

His first solo outing was Stranger In This Town , a blues-influenced album that was recieved well by many critics and guitar affectionados. Eric Clapton made an appearance on the album but it did not fare too well commercially. Richie later admitted that this was due to the fact that he was writing songs from an artistic point, rather than writing a radio oriented album. However, the album did establish Richie as a top rate guitarist, revealing a different side of him that was not widely recognisable during Bon Jovi's eight zero s heyday. His blues influences would later be present on some of Bon Jovi records as well, notably on one nine nine five 's These Days .

 Undiscovered Soul was Richie's second solo album, released in one nine nine eight . The album was produced by Don Was.
 
He lives in California and married actress Heather Locklear in one nine nine four . They had a daughter Ava Elizabeth in October one nine nine seven . In February two zero zero six , Locklear filed for divorce.

He has appeared in several movie and TV cameos, notably the film On The Line as 'The Mick', and the Chris Isaak show as himself. He contributed songs to the soundtracks of On The Line and Banger Sisters.

Recent ventures have seen him compose television theme tunes for both Entertainment Tonight and The Insider. He is a shareholder of Philadelphia Soul, an Arena Football League football team. 

Over the years, Richie has been an ardent fundraiser for many charities, such as Dream Street, the Steve Young Foundation and Michael J Fox's Parkinson's charity.

 '''Ambridge''' is a borough located in Beaver County in western Pennsylvania, incorporated in one nine one zero and named after the American Bridge Company which had significant operations there. Ambridge is located one six miles ( two five km) northwest of Pittsburgh alongside the Ohio river. In one nine one zero , five , two zero five people lived in Ambridge; in one nine two zero , one two , seven three zero people lived there, and in one nine four zero , one eight , nine six eight people resided in Ambridge. As of the two zero zero zero census, the borough had a total population of seven , seven six nine . 

The Harmony Society first settled the area in the early one eight zero zero s, founding the village of Oekonomie or Old Economy in one eight two four . Although initially successful, accumulating significant landholdings, the sect went into decline.
 
By the end of the nineteenth century only a few Harmonists remained. In one nine zero five the Society was dissolved and its vast real estate holdings sold, much of it to the American Bridge Company who subsequently enlarged the town and renamed it Ambridge.

Ambridge had been a highly productive place at one time. The people were occupied in bridge building, metal molding, and the manufacture of tubes (large iron pipes). During World War II, numerous small vessels such as LSTs were constructed in Ambridge by American Bridge Company. ABC ended operations in Ambridge in one nine eight three .

 Geography

 '''Beaver''' is a borough located in Beaver County, Pennsylvania, at the confluence of the Beaver and Ohio Rivers. As of the two zero zero zero census, the borough had a total population of four , seven seven five , having dropped from five , six four one in one nine four zero . It is the county seat of Beaver County. 

Robert Linn was the mayor of Beaver for five eight years ( one nine four six  two zero zero four ), making him the longest serving mayor in the United States. The borough was the home of influential U. S. Senator Boss Quay. The Beaver area is also the hometown of ''Survivor: All-Stars'' winner Amber Brkich.

 History 

The area around Beaver was originally home to the Shawnee tribe. Later the Mingo, Lenape, and other displaced groups moved into the area. The area was part of the Ohio Country that was in dispute during the French and Indian War. 

Beaver became the site of Fort McIntosh, a Revolutionary War era Patriot frontier fort. After the war, the fort was the home of the First American Regiment, the oldest active unit in the US Army. The fort was abandoned in one seven eight eight and razed a short time later. By then, the frontier had moved westward and there was no further need for a permanent garrison to protect the area. 

The town was laid out in one seven nine two . In one eight zero zero , it became the county seat of the newly formed Beaver County. the first county court was established in the town in one eight zero four . The town's growth was steady until one eight seven nine when the arrival of the Pittsburgh and Lake Erie Railroad caused a major growth spurt. In February one eight eight four a massive flood caused extensive damage. In one nine seven four , an archeological excavation was conducted at the site of Fort McIntosh.

 Geography 
Beaver is located at four zero  four one ' three eight  North, eight zero  one eight ' two nine  West ( four zero . six nine three eight six five , - eight zero . three zero seven nine four four ).

According to the United States Census Bureau, the borough has a total area of two . eight km ( one . one mi ).  two . four km ( zero . nine mi ) of it is land and zero . four km ( zero . two mi ) of it is water. The total area is one three . eight nine % water.

 Demographics 
As of the census of two zero zero zero , there are four , seven seven five people, two , one one two households, and one , two six zero families residing in the borough. The population density is one , nine eight two . four km ( five , one one nine . three mi ). There are two , two nine seven housing units at an average density of nine five three . six km ( two , four six two . six mi ). The racial makeup of the borough is nine six . four four % White, two . six four % African American, zero . one three % Native American, zero . two seven % Asian, zero . zero zero % Pacific Islander, zero . two seven % from other races, and zero . two five % from two or more races.  zero . eight eight % of the population are Hispanic or Latino of any race.

There are two , one one two households out of which two three . two % have children under the age of one eight living with them, four nine . six % are married couples living together, eight . one % have a female householder with no husband present, and four zero . three % are non-families. three six . nine % of all households are made up of individuals and one nine . nine % have someone living alone who is six five years of age or older. The average household size is two . one four and the average family size is two . eight three .

 '''Beaver Falls''' is a city located in Beaver County, Pennsylvania. It is located three one miles ( five zero km) northwest of Pittsburgh, and on the Beaver River, six miles ( nine km) from its confluence with the Ohio River. A variety of manufacturing plants had kept the residents busy in the twentieth century, however, the city has suffered a goodly amount of economic malaise lately due to the decline in the steel-making capacity in the Pittsburgh region where Beaver Falls is situated. Originally called Brighton, Beaver Falls was chartered as a borough in one eight six eight . It adopted the commission form of government in one nine one three . Population counts were as follows: in one eight nine zero , nine , seven three five ; in one nine zero zero , one zero , zero five four ; in one nine one zero , one two , one nine one ; in one nine two zero , one two , eight zero two ; and in one nine four zero , one seven , zero nine eight . As of the two zero zero zero census, the city had a total population of nine , nine two zero , with the drop in its population being attributable to its being centrally located within the Rust Belt.

The city is perhaps best known in fiction as the setting of the television situation comedy ''Mr. Belvedere''.

 '''Monaca''' is a borough located in Beaver County, Pennsylvania, along the Ohio River, two five miles ( four zero km) west of Pittsburgh. Fire clay is found in large quantities in the vicinity. Earlier in its history manufacturing was carried on here. Manufactories made tons of enameled porcelain ware, glass, tile, tubing, drawn steel and wire, tools, etc. Thiel College was founded here in one eight six six and moved to Greenville five years later. In one nine zero zero , two , zero zero eight people lived here; in one nine one zero , three , three seven six ; and in one nine four zero . seven , zero six one people were residents. As of the two zero zero zero census, the borough had a total population of six , two eight six .

In early November two zero zero three , the largest hepatitis A outbreak in American history occurred due to contaminated green onions at the defunct Chi-Chi's Mexican restaurant in the Beaver Valley Mall in Monaca. There were at least six six zero confirmed cases, four of which died.

 '''Rochester''' is a borough in Beaver County, Pennsylvania, two five miles ( four zero km) northwest of Pittsburgh at the confluence of the Beaver and Ohio Rivers.  '''Bedford''' is a borough located in Bedford County, Pennsylvania, eight five miles ( one three seven km) west by south of the State Capital, Harrisburg. Bedford was chartered in one seven nine five . Originally called Raystown, it was settled about one seven five one and laid out in one seven six six . For many years it was an important frontier military post. Population counts follow: one eight nine zero , two , two four two ; one nine zero zero , two , one six seven ; one nine one zero , two , three eight five . As of the two zero zero zero census, the borough had a total population of three , one four one . It is the county seat of Bedford County.

Bedford is notable for having been the headquarters of George Washington and his force of one three , zero zero zero while putting down the Whiskey Rebellion in one seven nine four .

 Geography

 '''Everett''' is a borough located in Bedford County, Pennsylvania. As of the two zero zero zero census, the borough had a total population of one , nine zero five .

Everett's original name was Bloody Run, after a creek which was the site of a battle between settlers and Native Americans. The town was renamed in honor of politician and orator Edward Everett.

Bestselling American novelist Dean Koontz was born in Everett.

 Geography 
Everett is located at four zero  zero ' five one  North, seven eight  two two ' two four  West ( four zero . zero one four zero four nine , - seven eight . three seven three two zero two ).

According to the United States Census Bureau, the borough has a total area of two . eight km ( one . one mi ).  two . eight km ( one . one mi ) of it is land and none of the area is covered with water.

Located in a valley of the Allegheny Mountains, Everett sits within a natural transportation corridor where the Raystown Branch of the Juniata River has carved a water gap through Tussey Mountain. The Alleghenies are a sub-region of the much larger Appalachian Mountains, and cover an area of central Pennsylvania, western Maryland and northern West Virginia. The countryside surrounding Everett is composed mainly of large forested areas, extensive agricultural fields, pasture, small villages, and woodlots.

 Demographics 
As of the census of two zero zero zero , there are one , nine zero five people, eight seven six households, and five one five families residing in the borough. The population density is six eight seven . four km ( one , seven seven three . four mi ). There are nine six seven housing units at an average density of three four eight . nine km ( nine zero zero . two mi ). The racial makeup of the borough is nine eight . four three % White, zero . five two % African American, zero . zero zero % Native American, zero . two six % Asian, zero . zero zero % Pacific Islander, zero . two six % from other races, and zero . five two % from two or more races.  zero . five two % of the population are Hispanic or Latino of any race.

There are eight seven six households out of which two seven . six % have children under the age of one eight living with them, four three . five % are married couples living together, one two . zero % have a female householder with no husband present, and four one . one % are non-families. three eight . five % of all households are made up of individuals and one eight . three % have someone living alone who is six five years of age or older. The average household size is two . one five and the average family size is two . seven nine .

In the borough the population is spread out with two two . nine % under the age of one eight , eight . six % from one eight to two four , two six . three % from two five to four four , two one . six % from four five to six four , and two zero . six % who are six five years of age or older. '''Kutztown''' is a borough located in Berks County, Pennsylvania, one eight miles ( two nine km) west southwest of Allentown and one seven miles ( two seven km) northeast of Reading. Other boroughs in the area include Lyons, Pennsylvania, Topton, Pennsylvania, Fleetwood, Pennsylvania, Kempton, Pennsylvania, Lenhartsville, Pennsylvania, Albany, Pennsylvania, and Trexlertown, Pennsylvania. Townships include Maxatawny Township, Greenwich Township, Pennsylvania, (officially pronounced 'green-witch') and Albany Township, Berks County, Pennsylvania (from which the village of Albany, Pennsylvania, takes its name. As of the two zero zero zero census, the borough has a total population of five , zero six seven . It is the site of Kutztown University. In one nine nine six then-President Bill Clinton visited and spoke at the University and in two zero zero four President George W. Bush visited and spoke in the beginning of his campaign. Other notable speakers include Margaret Thatcher, the former Prime Minister of the United Kingdom, and Colin Powell, former United States Secretary of State. 'Welcome to Kutztown' sign on East Main Street
 


 Notable natives 
 World-famous artist Keith Haring was born in Kutztown.
 The Kutztown one three , a group of students from Kutztown High School charged with felony computer trespass.
 Andre Reed played football for Kutztown University and then went on to play for the ''Buffalo Bills'' for many years.

Economy
West Main Street from Whiteoak Street.
Kutztown's economy is strong and diverse, with workers employed in agriculture, manufacturing, education (mainly at Kutztown University) and the service sector. East Penn Manufacturing , the maker of the world famous Deka Battery is located three miles outside of the town, and is a major employer in the area. Other major manufacturers include McConway and Torley, a major maker of steel railcar fittings, Radius Toothbrush, and at one time, the brand of athletic shoe known as the  Saucony.

''A Brief History of Kutztown'', as told by the  Kutztown Historical Society

The seeds of Kutztown were sown on June one six , one seven five five when George (Coots) Kutz purchased one three zero acres from Peter Wentz (who patented much of what is now known as Maxatawny Township on December one , one seven two four ). Kutz first laid out his plans for the town in one seven seven nine . The first lots in the new town of Cootstown (later named Kutztown) were purchased in one seven eight five by Adam Dietrich and Henry Schweier. The town was located on the Easton Road, a main road in colonial Pennsylvania, and was a lodging place for many travelers as it was a one-day ride from both Reading and Allentown.

Kutztown grew throughout the colonial period and during the early years of the United States. It was incorporated as a borough on April seven , one eight one five . It is the second oldest borough in Berks County (Reading became a borough in one seven eight three , then became a city in one eight four seven ).

As with the rest of Berks County, Kutztown was settled mainly by Germans, most of whom came from an area in southwest Germany called the Palatinate, which borders the Rhine River.

The Kutztown area, broadly defined, encompasses an area of land also known as the East Penn Valley, a broad limestone valley situated in northern and eastern Berks County, bounded by the Blue Mountain and South Mountain ranges to the north and south, respectively, by the Lehigh County border to the east, and by the Ontelaunee Creek (or Maiden Creek) to the west.
